entries.title: Ask for changes to a card by replying
entries.body: Cards no longer offer a Revise or Explain more button. Every button on a card now closes it. Ask for changes by replying under the card, and your answers go with the reply. Plans offer Approve and build beside a way to wait. A card already on your stack keeps its button until its author revises it.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
